profiles.name: Modern DX12
profiles.tryWhen: Recent DirectX 12 games that stutter, show corrupted shadows or crash under the default.
profiles.shortHint: Stutter or crashes in new games

profiles.name: DX11 alternative
profiles.tryWhen: DirectX 11 games with flicker, missing effects or a black screen under D3DMetal.
profiles.fallbackHint: If DXMT still fails to start, switch Graphics to DXVK.

profiles.name: Older 3D game
profiles.tryWhen: DirectX 9 or 10 games from roughly 2005 to 2013.

profiles.name: Unity or Unreal launcher
profiles.tryWhen: Games that open a small settings window first and then hang or never start.

profiles.name: Web-based launcher
profiles.tryWhen: Store launchers built on Electron or Chromium that show a blank white window.

profiles.name: Hides too many cores
profiles.tryWhen: Games that stutter or crash on start on M-series Pro, Max and Ultra chips.

profiles.name: Native DualSense
profiles.tryWhen: Games with real DualShock or DualSense support (adaptive triggers, touchpad).
